Job Description
 Position Summary: 
 Temporary or special appointment type, part-time or full-time Research Scientist/Scholar I positions may become available throughout the year in the Department of Soil and Crop Sciences. Research areas may include crop breeding and genetics, soil ecology, soil health, agroecology, microbiome science, and biogeochemistry. 

 Salary Range:
 $62,000 - $92,000

 Essential Job Duties: 
 Conduct independent and collaborative research in one or more areas of soil and crop sciences. 
 Design, implement, and manage research projects and experiments. 
 Collect, analyze, and interpret scientific data. 
 Prepare technical reports, presentations, and scholarly publications. 
 Contribute to grant-funded research activities and project objectives. 
 Collaborate with faculty, staff, students, and external partners. 
 Support department research, outreach, and educational missions. 
 Maintain compliance with university, sponsor, and laboratory requirements. 
 
 Supervision: 
 May supervise research personnel, graduate students, undergraduate students, or temporary employees as assigned. 

 Minimum Qualifications: 
 Completed Ph.D. or equivalent degree in a relevant field, from an accredited institution by the start date of employment. 
 
 Preferred Qualifications: 
 Experience in one or more of the following areas: crop breeding and genetics, soil ecology, soil health, agroecology, microbiome science, or biogeochemistry. 
 Demonstrated record of scientific research and publication. 
 Ability to work effectively in collaborative research environments. 
 

 Conditions of Employment: 
 Pre-employment Criminal Background Check (required for all new hires). 
 Must be legally authorized to work in the U.S. by employment start date. Department willnot sponsor a Visa. 
 
 Application Instructions:
 To apply, please upload a resume and cover letter. 

 This is an evergreen posting. Applications will be reviewed as hiring needs arise, and qualified applicants may be contacted by individual faculty members if a suitable opportunity becomes available.

 This pool will expire on May 30, 2027. Applicants wishing to be considered beyond this date must reapply.
 
 Please note, applicants may redact information from their application materials that identifies their age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.

 Background Check Policy Statement
 
 Colorado State University strives to provide a safe study, work, and living environment for its faculty, staff, volunteers and students. To support this environment and comply with applicable laws and regulations, CSU conducts background checks for the finalist before a final offer. The type of background check conducted varies by position and can include, but is not limited to, criminal history, sex offender registry, motor vehicle history, financial history, and/or education verification. Background checks will also be conducted when required by law or contract and when, in the discretion of the University, it is reasonable and prudent to do so.
 
 EEO
 Colorado State University (CSU) provides equal employment opportunities to all applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.
